lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five horizontal rows along the lateral mid-section, posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, forming a rectilinear grid of anchor nodes across the central lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single dominant horizontal ridge is visible on the upper flank, characterized by a high-intensity luminance edge on the dorsal aspect and a corresponding shadow gradient on the ventral aspect.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin, visible in the upper-left quadrant, displays a low-density distribution of small, high-luminance spots relative to the lateral flank density.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of three distinct high-contrast silhouettes of commensal teleost fish (remoras) positioned ventrally and posterior to the pectoral fin.
